english.title: Refuse to submit to eyesight test required under section 96(2) RTA 1988
english.standardoffencewording: On **(..SPECIFY DATE..) at **(..SPECIFY TOWNSHIP..), having been required by a constable under section 96(2) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 to submit to a test for the purpose of ascertaining whether, using no other means than you used at the time of driving, you could comply with a requirement as to eyesight prescribed under Part III of that Act, refused to submit to that test
english.legislation: Contrary to section 96(3) of the Road Traffic Act 1988 and Schedule 2 to the Road Traffic Offenders Act 1988.
